Name: SKU Stockout Risk Tier
Expression: SWITCH(TRUE(), [Days of Supply] < 7, IF(SUM('Inventory'[on_hand_qty]) <= 0, "P0 Stockout", IF(AVERAGE('Inventory'[actual_lead_time_days]) > 21, "P1 Critical", "P2 Expedite")), [Days of Supply] < 14, "P2 Watchlist", "Healthy")

Name: Static 14-Day Reorder Alert
Expression: IF([Days of Supply] < 14 || [Fill Rate Pct] < 0.85, "ALERT: Reorder Immediately - At Risk", "OK")
